# Health Star Academy

> CDPH-approved hybrid CNA training in Stockton, Sacramento, Hayward & the Bay Area. Online theory + in-person clinicals. 6-week daytime or 8-weekend tracks. $2,499 tuition + $175 enrollment fee.

Health Star Academy is a state-approved Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) school serving the Central Valley and the Bay Area of California. Students complete 60 hours of online theory and 100 hours of in-person clinicals at partner skilled-nursing facilities in Stockton, Lodi, and Hayward. The program is hybrid by design — students keep working while training and finish in as little as 6 weeks.
